comment_box:
To put simply: The last thing we need right now is to limit even more life-saving resources from veterans who risked their lives for this country. To ban abortion for veterans who experience incest or rape is horrible, and honestly has me questioning if this administration really cares about its soldiers.

Regarding the note that life-saving abortions will be an exception: We know from experience that if abortion is banned for everything but the life of the mother that doctors hesitate to provide life-saving care, and sometimes they hesitate too long and the life of the mother is no longer a concern. We need to stop limiting access for people who need it, and we need to allow our veterans to make decisions for what is best for themselves, their families, and their lives. Thank our veterans by giving them the resources to do so.
